4. // Package config handles parsing and applying options from finch's config
5. // file. These options can be applied to any aspect of the project, from the VMM
6. // to components running inside the VM.

8. // Currently, VMM options are applied to one of Lima's configuration files and options
9. // within the VM are applied via running SSH commands and writing files via SFTP.

29. // AdditionalDirectory represents the additional directory used in Finch config.
30. type AdditionalDirectory struct {

34. // Finch represents the configuration file for Finch CLI.
35. type Finch struct {
36. 	CPUs   *int    `yaml:"cpus"`
37. 	Memory *string `yaml:"memory"`
38. 	// AdditionalDirectories are the work directories that are not supported by default. In macOS, only home directory is supported by default.
39. 	// For example, if you want to mount a directory into a container, and that directory is not under your home directory,
40. 	// then you'll need to specify this field to add that directory or any ascendant of it as a work directory.
41. 	AdditionalDirectories []AdditionalDirectory `yaml:"additional_directories,omitempty"`
42. 	// VMType sets which technology to use for Finch's VM.
43. 	// Currently supports `qemu` and `vz` (Virtualization.framework).
44. 	// Also sets mountType to "virtiofs", instead of the default "reverse-sshfs"
45. 	// Requires macOS 13.0 or later.
46. 	// This setting will only be applied on vm init.
47. 	VMType *limayaml.VMType `yaml:"vmType,omitempty"`
48. 	// Use Rosetta 2 when available. Forces vmType to "vz" (Virtualization.framework) if set to `true`.
49. 	// Requires macOS 13.0 or later and an Apple Silicon (ARM64) mac.
50. 	// Has no effect on systems where Rosetta 2 is not available (Intel/AMD64 macs, or macOS < 13.0).
51. 	// This setting will only be applied on vm init.
52. 	Rosetta *bool `yaml:"rosetta,omitempty"`

93. // writeConfig writes a config struct back to a YAML file at a path.
94. func writeConfig(cfg *Finch, fs afero.Fs, path string) error {
95. 	cfgBuf, err := yaml.Marshal(cfg)
96. 	if err != nil {
97. 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write to marshal config: %w", err)
98. 	}
99. 
100. 	if err := afero.WriteFile(fs, path, cfgBuf, 0o755); err != nil {
101. 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write to config file: %w", err)
102. 	}
103. 
104. 	return nil
105. }

107. func ensureConfigDir(fs afero.Fs, path string, log flog.Logger) error {
108. 	dirExists, err := afero.DirExists(fs, path)
109. 	if err != nil {
110. 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get status of config directory: %w", err)
111. 	}
112. 	if !dirExists {
113. 		log.Infof("%q directory doesn't exist, attempting to create it", path)
114. 		if err := fs.Mkdir(path, 0o755); err != nil {
115. 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create config directory: %w", err)
116. 		}
117. 	}
118. 	return nil
119. }

121. // Load loads Finch's configuration from a YAML file and initializes default values.
122. func Load(fs afero.Fs, cfgPath string, log flog.Logger, systemDeps LoadSystemDeps, mem fmemory.Memory) (*Finch, error) {
123. 	b, err := afero.ReadFile(fs, cfgPath)
124. 	if err != nil {
125. 		if errors.Is(err, afero.ErrFileNotFound) {
126. 			log.Infof("Using default values due to missing config file at %q", cfgPath)
127. 			defCfg := applyDefaults(&Finch{}, systemDeps, mem)
128. 			if err := ensureConfigDir(fs, path.Dir(cfgPath), log); err != nil {
129. 				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to ensure %q directory: %w", cfgPath, err)
130. 			}
131. 			if err := writeConfig(defCfg, fs, cfgPath); err != nil {
132. 				return nil, err
133. 			}
134. 			return defCfg, nil
135. 		}
136. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read the config file: %w", err)
137. 	}
138. 
139. 	var cfg Finch
140. 	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(b, &cfg); err != nil {
141. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal config file: %w", err)
142. 	}
143. 
144. 	defCfg := applyDefaults(&cfg, systemDeps, mem)
145. 	if err := writeConfig(defCfg, fs, cfgPath); err != nil {
146. 		return nil, err
147. 	}
148. 
149. 	if err := validate(defCfg, log, systemDeps, mem); err != nil {
150. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to validate config file: %w", err)
151. 	}
152. 
153. 	return defCfg, nil
154. }

156. // SupportsVirtualizationFramework checks if the user's system supports Virtualization.framework.
157. func SupportsVirtualizationFramework(cmdCreator command.Creator) (bool, error) {
158. 	cmd := cmdCreator.Create("sw_vers", "-productVersion")
159. 	out, err := cmd.Output()
160. 	if err != nil {
161. 		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to run sw_vers command: %w", err)
162. 	}
163. 
164. 	splitVer := strings.Split(string(out), ".")
165. 	if len(splitVer) == 0 {
166. 		return false, fmt.Errorf("unexpected result from string split: %v", splitVer)
167. 	}
168. 
169. 	majorVersionInt, err := strconv.ParseInt(splitVer[0], 10, 64)
170. 	if err != nil {
171. 		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse split sw_vers output (%s) into int: %w", splitVer[0], err)
172. 	}
173. 
174. 	if majorVersionInt >= 13 {
175. 		return true, nil
176. 	}
177. 
178. 	return false, nil
179. }

38. func GetVMStatus(creator command.LimaCmdCreator, logger flog.Logger, instanceName string) (VMStatus, error) {

42. 	if err != nil {

224. func handleEnv(systemDeps NerdctlCommandSystemDeps, arg, arg2 string) (bool, string) {
225. 	var (
226. 		envVar string
227. 		skip   bool
228. 	)
229. 	switch arg {
230. 	case "-e", "--env":
231. 		skip = true
232. 		envVar = arg2
233. 	default:
234. 		// flag and value are in the same string
235. 		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-e") {
236. 			envVar = arg[2:]
237. 		} else {
238. 			// only other case is "--env="; skip that prefix
239. 			envVar = arg[6:]
240. 		}
241. 	}
242. 
243. 	if strings.Contains(envVar, "=") {
244. 		return skip, envVar
245. 	}
246. 	// if no value was provided we need to check the OS environment
247. 	// for a value and only set if it exists in the current env
248. 	if val, ok := systemDeps.LookupEnv(envVar); ok {
249. 		return skip, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", envVar, val)
250. 	}
251. 	// no value found; do not set the variable in the env

255. func handleEnvFile(fs afero.Fs, systemDeps NerdctlCommandSystemDeps, arg, arg2 string) (bool, []string, error) {
256. 	var (
257. 		filename string
258. 		skip     bool
259. 	)
260. 
261. 	switch arg {
262. 	case "--env-file":
263. 		skip = true
264. 		filename = arg2
265. 	default:
266. 		filename = arg[11:]
267. 	}
268. 
269. 	file, err := fs.Open(filepath.Clean(filename))
270. 	if err != nil {
271. 		return false, []string{}, err
272. 	}
273. 	defer file.Close() //nolint:errcheck // We did not write to the file, and the file will be closed when the CLI process exits anyway.
274. 
275. 	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
276. 
277. 	var envs []string
278. 	for scanner.Scan() {
279. 		line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
280. 		if len(line) == 0 {
281. 			continue
282. 		}
283. 		switch {
284. 		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "#"):
285. 			// ignore comments
286. 			continue
287. 		case !strings.Contains(line, "="):
288. 			// only has the variable name; need to lookup value
289. 			if val, ok := systemDeps.LookupEnv(line); ok {
290. 				envs = append(envs, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", line, val))
291. 			}
292. 		default:
293. 			// contains a name and value
294. 			envs = append(envs, line)
295. 		}
296. 	}
297. 	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
298. 		return skip, []string{}, err
299. 	}

data.content:
Updated Finch for `github.com/lima-vm/lima` **v0.15.1**.

Changed:
- `go.mod` / `go.sum` now resolve Lima `v0.15.1` and its updated transitive deps.
- `pkg/config/lima_config_applier.go` now uses `*bool` values for `limayaml.Rosetta.Enabled` and `limayaml.Rosetta.BinFmt`, matching Lima 0.15.1’s API.
- Rosetta is explicitly disabled with `false` pointers when switching away from Rosetta/VZ behavior, preserving prior Finch semantics.

Validation: source packages compile against the upgraded dependency with `go test ./... -run TestDoesNotExist`. The unmodified local config test assertions still compare Lima’s old `bool` Rosetta fields directly, so those specific pre-upgrade assertions are incompatible with Lima 0.15.1’s new pointer fields.
